title: New Lagos Rising Again
author: Lior Pemberton
blurb: Zephyrine Winterbourne, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
